detail.longDescription: # GitHub may have a data # leak ... Yesterday I got a spam message sent to my dedicated GitHub email address. "Dedicated" means I only use it to log into GitHub. The option to "Keep my email addresses private" is active. As far as I can tell, I'm not leaking this email address anywhere myself. A Google search turns up nothing. Soooo, is it just me, or is there anyone else who got the impression there's something wrong? Maybe the recent # outage is related? # dataprotection # breach
